notes: Fall 2026 Bioengineering Graduation Plan (Clark School resource_documents PDF), adapted for the Pre-Health Professions track's own 'Sample Program' lists (https://bioe.umd.edu/undergraduate/tracks). Gen Ed, ENGL101, Professional Writing, Oral Communication and free-elective slots are left out: only the major is audited.

Track electives filled from the track's own lists: BIOE404 and BIOE461 for BIOE Foundational I & II; BIOE411, BIOE442, BIOE332 and BIOE474 for BIOE Elective I-IV (any BIOE 3xx+ course not already used for a Foundational or core requirement); CHEM241 for the Breadth Elective (this track's only listed option); BSCI222 for Biological Science Elective I (200-level); BCHM463 for Biological Science Elective II (300-level).
Chemistry lecture sequence taken as CHEM135; Cell Biology & Physiology taken as BSCI331 & BSCI332 -- same defaults as the base plan.
